name: TranscriptAPI
tagline: Give your agents accurate transcripts from any audio or video.
install_steps: Get an API key at transcriptapi.com.
Tell your Grok Bot to call TranscriptAPI whenever you share an audio or video URL.
Paste the prompt below so transcription becomes a standing capability.
prompt: You can transcribe audio and video. Whenever I share a link to a recording, podcast, or video, call TranscriptAPI (https://transcriptapi.com) with my API key, get back the transcript with timestamps, and return clean, readable text. If I ask, pull just the segment around a timestamp I name.
pricing_note: Usage-based API; free tier to start.
description:
## What it does

TranscriptAPI turns any audio or video into an accurate transcript with a single API call — timestamps included, no pipeline to build. It is the fast way to give a Grok Bot the ability to read recordings, podcasts, meetings and videos, so anything spoken becomes text your bot can search, summarize and act on.

## Use it in Grok Bot

Give your bot the prompt below and an API key. From then on, dropping a recording link into the chat gets you a clean transcript back, and you can ask the bot to pull just the part around a timestamp.

Paste the prompt on this page into a Grok Bot and connect your account — that is the whole setup.
